derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G5043 (τέκνον);

occurrences.text: Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.
